blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable by keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Render the delete action as a native `<button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={onDelete}>`. A keyboard user pressing Tab never lands on the div (no tabindex), and Enter or Space does nothing (no key handler); a screen reader user hears no role, so the only action of the toolbar cannot be found or triggered without a mouse — WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value. The native button brings focus, Enter/Space activation and the button role at once.
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable by keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, e.g. `aria-label="Delete document"` on the button (or visually hidden text inside it). Its only content is `TrashIcon`, whose `<svg ... aria-hidden="true">` (src/components/icons.tsx:3) hides it from assistive technology, so a screen reader user reaching the control hears nothing that says it deletes the document — WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: Add a text alternative naming the owner, e.g. `alt={`${ownerName}'s avatar`}` (the component then needs the owner's name as a prop), or `alt=""` if the owner is named in adjacent text. With no `alt`, screen readers announce the image file name or URL instead of who owns the document, so the information the avatar conveys is lost — WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content.
findings.title: Owner avatar image has no alt attribute

findings.recommendation: The `icon-button` class is styled outside the change and the trash icon is 16 by 16 pixels (src/components/icons.tsx:3). Check that the control is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or spaced enough (WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)) and that it shows a visible focus indicator once it is a button (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible).
findings.title: Delete target size and focus style not verifiable in the diff
